verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'leaving Earth on April 1'; R2: 'lifted off ... at 6:35 p.m. EDT' (context April 1); R3: 'April 1, 2026'; R6: launch on April 1, 2026
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the launch date as April 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is being broadcast 24/7 on NASA's YouTube channel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '24/7 coverage will continue on NASA’s YouTube channel'; R1: 'go to NASA's YouTube channel to watch archived coverage'; R6: 'NASA plans to continue broadcasting live views of the Artemis II mission ... on its YouTube page'
verifications.reasoning: R2 explicitly states 24/7 coverage on YouTube; supported by others.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is being broadcast 24/7 on NASA+.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions 24/7 broadcast specifically on NASA+; R2 notes NASA+ coverage concludes.

verifications.claim: NASA's broadcast of the Artemis II mission shows live views from the Orion spacecraft as it travels to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA's live feed of a camera on the Orion spacecraft'; R2: 'live views from Artemis II's Orion spacecraft'; R6: 'stream live views of space from Orion'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm live views from Orion during travel to Moon.

verifications.claim: NASA provides dedicated feeds showing views from the Orion spacecraft as it orbits the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lunar flyby'; 'loop around the moon'; no mention of orbiting the Moon
verifications.reasoning: Mission is a flyby/loop around Moon, not orbit; no dedicated feeds specified for orbiting.

verifications.claim: The AROW (Artemis Real-time Orbit Website) tracks the Orion capsule's position relative to Earth and the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'track where Orion ... distance from Earth, distance from the Moon'; 'see where Orion currently is relative to their position on Earth'
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly describes AROW tracking Orion relative to Earth and Moon.

verifications.claim: The AROW includes an augmented reality feature on the mobile app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'The mobile app ... with the addition of augmented reality tracker'
verifications.reasoning: R5 explicitly states AR feature on mobile app.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is journeying around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'journey around the moon'; R2: 'mission around the Moon'; R3: 'fly around the moon'; R5: 'journey around the Moon'; R6: 'trip around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm mission trajectory around the Moon.
